title: Tiny, cute gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bag body -->
  <rect x='28' y='38' width='44' height='46' rx='6' fill='#FF4D87'/>
  <!-- bag bottom shading -->
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='44' height='14' rx='6' fill='#E0326E'/>
  <!-- bag top fold band -->
  <rect x='28' y='38' width='44' height='10' rx='4' fill='#FF7FA8'/>
  <!-- side highlight -->
  <rect x='32' y='42' width='6' height='36' rx='3' fill='#FF9DBD'/>
  <!-- left handle -->
  <path d='M40 38 q0 -16 10 -16' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right handle -->
  <path d='M60 38 q0 -16 -10 -16' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <path d='M41 36 q1 -13 9 -13' stroke='#FFEE99' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59 36 q-1 -13 -9 -13' stroke='#FFEE99' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bow left loop -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='43' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#4DC9FF' transform='rotate(-25 43 43)'/>
  <!-- bow right loop -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='43' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#4DC9FF' transform='rotate(25 57 43)'/>
  <!-- bow knot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#8FE6FF'/>
  <!-- bow tails -->
  <path d='M47 47 l-5 7 l6 -2 z' fill='#4DC9FF'/>
  <path d='M53 47 l5 7 l-6 -2 z' fill='#4DC9FF'/>
  <!-- polka dots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#FFD6E4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#FFD6E4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#FFD6E4'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#FFD6E4'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#FFD6E4'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='74' r='2' fill='#FFD6E4'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FFD6E4'/>
</svg>
